speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are presenting with a fever and abdominal tenderness shortly after giving birth. To help me determine the cause, how many weeks postpartum are you, and have you experienced any foul-smelling vaginal discharge or painful urination?

speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old woman. The patient is in the postpartum period after delivering an 11 pound boy vaginally at 40 weeks gestation. She experienced a prolonged course during labor. She reports increased frequency of urination and uterine tenderness. She also mentions a decrease in bowel sounds.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Postpartum Uterine Atony (with secondary pyelonephritis or cystitis)

I am concerned about the decreased bowel sounds and uterine tenderness you described. REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count (CBC), Urinalysis, and Uterine Size Assessment.
